raw_voice_quotes.label: The Anchor Principle — ORIGIN Articulation
raw_voice_quotes.verbatim: Focus on they don't know in a sentence instead of what they do know. For example, I'll ask how the heck are you and so I'm saying, how are you but they focus on the heck instead of the how are you part they know so that's I want to remind them of that principle to just relax when I talk and try to listen casually for what they know already instead of focusing what they don't know

target_sounds.mouth_shape_tip: Sneeze sound: tongue touches roof, quick burst of air. Train engine: Ch-ch-ch!
Bunny teeth: top teeth touch bottom lip, blow air out
The Librarian: round lips, blow steady air (no tongue touch)

phonics_focus.drill_example: Watch vs Wash (punchy CH vs smooth SH)

pedagogical_frameworks.name: Detective Mode vs Flow Mode
pedagogical_frameworks.detective_mode: brain treats every unfamiliar word as high-stakes puzzle — hits unknown, stops, crashes
pedagogical_frameworks.flow_mode: rides wave of sentence, grabs known words (anchors), ignores noise

pedagogical_frameworks.name: The Anchor Principle (Gemini Expansion)
pedagogical_frameworks.core_insight: Treat sentences as sea of words with anchors, not chain where one broken link stops everything
pedagogical_frameworks.mechanism: unknown_word → stress → narrows_focus → deaf_to_what_follows | known_words → connect_dots → get_gist → stay_in_flow

drills.name: The Filter Game
drills.description: Throw nonsense words into common sentences. 'Please pass the flibber-gibbet salt.' Did you hear 'salt'? Good. Ignore the rest.

drills.name: The 80/20 Rule
drills.description: 80% of words = 100% of meaning. The 20% is flavor text.

drills.name: Positive Reinforcement
drills.description: When confused, ask 'What parts DID you recognize?' Prove the anchors were enough.

drills.name: Minimal Pairs
drills.description: Watch vs Wash, Much vs Mush (CH/SH distinction)

consolidation_notes.why_separate_from_bluetech: BlueTech extraction is 16-source NotebookLM analysis. This is RAW SOURCE SESSION where Michael first spoke the Anchor Principle to Gemini. Raw voice > derivative analysis. Verbatim quote here is canonical origin.
